title: GoodWe ESA GW9.999K-ETA-G20 (9.999 kW three-phase power module)

items.question: What backup rating does GW9.999K-ETA-G20 have?
items.answer: On the AC side (Back-up Port), the GW9.999K-ETA-G20 has a rated apparent power of 10 kVA. The maximum output overcurrent protection is 74.6 A.
items.answer_de: Auf der AC-Seite (Back-up-Anschluss) hat der GW9.999K-ETA-G20 eine Nennscheinleistung von 10 kVA. Der maximale Ausgangs-Überstromschutz beträgt 74,6 A.

citation.title: GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5)

items.question: How many MPPTs does GW9.999K-ETA-G20 have?
items.answer: The GW9.999K-ETA-G20 has 4 MPPTs, with 1 string per MPPT (1/1/1/1).
items.question_de: Wie viele MPPTs hat der GW9.999K-ETA-G20?
items.answer_de: Der GW9.999K-ETA-G20 hat 4 MPPTs, mit 1 Strang pro MPPT (1/1/1/1).

citation.title: GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5)

items.question: Which battery modules stack with this power module?
items.answer: The battery system models are GW5.1-BAT-D-G20, GW5.1-BAT-D-G21, GW8.3-BAT-D-G20, GW8.3-BAT-D-G21, GW6.0-BAT-D-G20 and GW9.0-BAT-D-G20. Battery modules of different models can be mixed. The system supports 5-108kWh.
items.question_de: Welche Batteriemodule gehören zu diesem Leistungsmodul?
items.answer_de: Die Batteriesystem-Modelle sind GW5.1-BAT-D-G20, GW5.1-BAT-D-G21, GW8.3-BAT-D-G20, GW8.3-BAT-D-G21, GW6.0-BAT-D-G20 und GW9.0-BAT-D-G20. Batteriemodule unterschiedlicher Modelle können gemischt werden. Das System unterstützt 5-108kWh.

citation.title: GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5)
